title: Correct distance OA
description: Essential: Final answer for part (1) is derived as $\frac{4v_0^2 \sin\theta}{g}$.

title: Correct maximum distance from PQ
description: Essential: Final answer for part (2) is derived as $\frac{v_0^2 \cos\theta}{2g}$.

title: Proper coordinate setup
description: Important: Establishes axes parallel and perpendicular to the slope PQ to decompose gravity and initial velocity.

title: Correct time of flight
description: Important: Derives the total flight time from the condition of zero displacement perpendicular to the slope at landing.

title: Applies given angle relation
description: Important: Correctly uses the condition $\alpha + \theta = 90^\circ$ to simplify trigonometric expressions (e.g., $\sin\alpha = \cos\theta$).

title: Kinematics along the slope
description: Important: For part (1), correctly calculates the displacement along the slope using constant acceleration equations.

title: Maximum height perpendicular to slope
description: Important: For part (2), correctly finds the maximum of the perpendicular displacement using kinematics or energy.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for the components of gravitational acceleration along or perpendicular to the slope.

title: Misinterprets distance from PQ
description: Pitfall: Calculates vertical height from ground or horizontal range instead of perpendicular distance from the line PQ.
